GREEN. The super-productivity migrated lane builds on Angular 16.

**What closed the four families**

1. **@ngx-formly closure correction** — `^7.1.0` → `^6.3.12` in `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/frameworks/angular/src/angular-target-cell.ts`. The mechanical rule did **not** misread: `@ngx-formly/core` declares the identical peer object on 6.1.8 through 7.1.0 — `{"@angular/forms": ">=13.2.0", "rxjs": "^6.5.3 || ^7.0.0"}`, no `@angular/core` peer, no engines — so peers are non-discriminating across three majors. What decides is the Angular version stamped in the published partial declarations: every 7.x carries `18.2.13`, every 6.x back to 6.1.8 carries `13.3.12`. Recorded as the **peer-strictness refinement**, made executable and tested (`majorOf`, `cellAcceptsBuildStamp`, `buildStampContradictions`). The u18e `FieldType<FieldTypeConfig>` edit re-checked against 6.3.12 — identical declarations, no re-run needed.
2. **`initMaterialCssVars`** — derivable, not an accommodation. The installed 5.0.3 declares `init-material-css-vars` at `_main.scss:76` (5 params, all defaulted). New capability `sass-mixin-hyphenation-successor` folds hyphen/underscore/case-boundary, requires exactly one folding match plus arity fit.
3. **JSON named import** — it was the resolveJsonModule interop. New capability `json-module-named-import`; also caught `environment.prod.ts`, which the production fileReplacements would have hit next.
4. **New family** (only reachable once the first three cleared): `url()` in `src/styles/font/material-icons.scss` written against the entry, which resolve-url-loader now rebases onto the partial. New capability `stylesheet-url-rebase`.

**Green close** — build ×2 exit 0, 58 artifacts, 57/58 byte-identical; the one difference is `ngsw.json`'s `timestamp` field alone. No Sass-random files differed. Whole-tree 89 → 92 differences; 5 files written, 4 capability-driven, **0 accommodations added**, u18h's 19 carried forward complete.

**Honest gap**: logical-name parity is a strict subset, 58 of the era's 64. Four of the six missing are the web workers — `new Worker('./lz.worker', …)` is the era string form, which webpack 5 does not recognise, so no chunk is emitted and no error is reported. Green build, workers would 404. Measured and recorded, not closed. The other two are `polyfills-es5`, removed by Angular 13.

Note: I ran past the 35-minute budget — two full production builds plus the extra family cost more than the packet assumed.
